summary_md: **ProductFlo.io ([@productflo_io](https://x.com/productflo_io/status/2115065331433533639))** documents a SolidWorks MCP bug: a CAD agent's screenshot calls returned blank white images while exports worked, so the agent silently couldn't see. A follow-up explains an inner call re-silenced the view before saving, and that the missing check is proving the image isn't blank before handing it to the agent.

referenced_urls.title: screenshot() writes a blank image: _require_model re-silences the view inside run_guarded · Issue #5 · hjbaard/SolidWorks-MCP

relevance: A concrete lesson in verifying perception tools in agentic CAD loops.
